{{Quote|Ten years ago he was considered an up-and-coming young politician, one of the brightest to have come out of Imperial Center over the past decade.|Vestin Axlon|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Bidor Ferrouz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], ruling from the Imperial palace on [[Poln Major]] in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. That year, Ferrouz contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] leader [[Vestin Axlon]], and offered the Alliance a base in the Candoras region. However, contacting the Rebellion was not Ferrouz's choice, as he had been forced to do so as a set of conditions forced upon him by the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] who had taken Ferrouz's [[Ferrouz's wife|wife]] and [[Ferrouz's daughter|daughter]] hostage. Even though the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was originally supposed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him for contacting the Rebellion, she later spared him, which was exactly what [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] wanted her to do, according to her later [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] conversation with him.
